## 27d29b6b289a

**Reproduced defect — `CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS` contains noncanonical rivals.**
Strict replay against all eight labeled canonical pairs produced:

| Declared name | Fits | Mismatches |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `repair_without_color_cycle` | 0/8 | 8/8 |
| `cycle_visible_only` | 0/8 | 8/8 |
| `numeric_sorted_cycle` | 4/8 | 4/8 |

These are useful lesson competitors but do not satisfy the contract for
`CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS`, whose members must fit every labeled canonical pair.
The strict semantic gate therefore fails before its otherwise useful generated
witness checks can be accepted. The selected generator accepted the retained
canonical witness as in-domain; the independently executed Racket authority
matched the canonical ledger and differed from the named rivals on their
witnesses.

The audit also found no task-local tests, despite associated notes referring to
historical tests. Recommended repair: remove these entries from
`CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS`, retain them in `LESSON_COMPETITORS`, add a true
canonical-fitting shortcut only when one is demonstrated, and restore portable
contract tests.
